0022600108.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-1, 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East) host the Washington Wizards (1-1, 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East) in the third game of the Bulls' season, and they have yet to play a home game this year (0-0 at home). The Bulls are coming off a win, while the Wizards lost their most recent game, and the Bulls are without Nic Claxton (hamstring), Noa Essengue (head bruise), and Patrick Williams (groin soreness), while the Wizards are without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Bulls won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 119-108 win in Washington on April 9, 2026.
